description: The router's route labels and tiers as its outcome lines named them before it wrote its models and levels itself (spec D9; the router's change is dated 2026-10-17, a log's first line with the fields may be later): the models behind the labels, the levels on each ability's scale, and the reasons of a qwen chain. core/levels.ts reads this for a line without those fields (a spawn without ability and workerModel, an escalate without ability, fromModel and toModel, a reroute without the model it names) and for no other. Old lines cannot change, so neither can this file.
